messages:
Sam (AE): Kicking off POC with Citrine Labs today — they want to validate a custom LLM for pharma QA. Main asks: private deployment, KMS, and a quantized 4-bit variant. Any immediate blockers?
Maya (SE): Thanks. Quick check: is the model on our catalog or partner registry? If not, variant onboarding needed + compatibility scan for KV cache and attention layers.
Ravi (Eng): It's not in catalog. We'll need the model repo + HF model card or ONNX. Also need tokenizer and model_type (causal/encoder-decoder).
Sam (AE): I can get the HF repo link and sample prompt set. Timeline: 2 weeks for POC start. Is that realistic?
Maya (SE): If they provide artifacts and we can use Hosted Dedicated for POC, 2 weeks is doable. If they require on-prem private, add ~1 week for infra/Networking & security review.
Olga (Security): KMS is okay but legal needs to confirm BYOK vs our managed keys. Priya, can you flag the SOC2/HIPAA supplement? :eyes: 
Priya (CS): Looping in legal — Lina (Legal) will fill the questionnaire. Also need data retention SLOs and audit log export path.
Lina (Legal): I'll take the questionnaire. Sam, send the security questionnaire link + intended VPC egress ranges.
Sam (AE): Sent link: https://redwood-internal/poctools/citrine-secq. Cc @Lina. Also they asked about token-level billing for hybrid routing — pricing note?
Maya (SE): For quantized 4-bit variant we recommend dedicated reserved capacity to hit throughput. Pricing estimate: ~0.45x per token vs full fp16 but licensing varies. I'll attach model sizing calc.
Ravi (Eng): Important: their model uses rotary embeddings; need to confirm our kernel path supports rotary + 4-bit quant on target GPU (A100 vs H100). If not, fallback to 8-bit quant.
Sam (AE): What's the minimal artifact set I should ask the customer for?
Maya (SE): HF repo or tarball, tokenizer files, example 50 prompts, desired seq-len, per-request latency SLO, expected qps. Also indicate if they need tool-calling or function outputs.
Olga (Security): One blocker: Citrine requires customer-managed key in GCP KMS. We support GCP KMS in Private and Dedicated; Hosted requires managed keys. Confirm deployment mode.
Priya (CS): I'll draft the deployment options matrix and a short handoff checklist. ETA EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: POC workspace created: citrine-poc-2765432100 — infra provisioning queued.
Sam (AE): Awesome. Thanks all. Next step: I'll collect artifacts and set up a kickoff with Citrine for Friday. @Maya schedule please.
